'''Jamilla Tabadi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Tabadi greeted a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] attuned to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Tabadi gave the spacer, who was already vetted by a mysterious [[Old Man (Dathomir)|old man]], the whereabouts of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[City/Legends|village]] named [[Aurilia]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jamilla Tabadi was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
